categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection services, focusing on environmental remediation, industrial pollution source treatment, and environmental product sales and services. The company’s main business includes soil and groundwater remediation, water body restoration, industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, and solid waste disposal. It also provides EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction), PC (Procurement Construction), technical consulting, and operation management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies such as long-term stabilization of heavy metals in soil, in-situ injection and cyclic extraction remediation for soil and groundwater, high-efficiency chemical oxidation with odor control, high-salinity and high-nitrogen industrial wastewater treatment, ECORs electro-catalytic oxidation, VOCs adsorption-desorption and solvent recovery, and sludge bio-leaching deep dehydration technology. It integrates multi-disciplinary approaches including microbiology, chemistry, and engineering to develop customized environmental solutions and smart environmental management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, water utilities, engineering contractors, pharmaceutical and chemical industries, and emerging sectors like photovoltaic and lithium battery manufacturing. The company serves clients requiring environmental remediation, industrial pollution control, and environmental equipment and services, primarily in China’s environmental protection market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated mainly in the East China region, including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, and Shanghai, with expanding presence in other regions such as North China, Central China, and Western China. It has projects and clients across multiple provinces, with strategic focus on Zhejiang and the Yangtze River Delta economic zone.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zone-King operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental remediation services, engineering contracting, and environmental equipment sales. It engages in project design, procurement, construction, operation, and maintenance, positioning itself as a comprehensive environmental solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven growth with strategic priorities on resource recycling, digital intelligence (smart environmental management), and equipment innovation. It invests significantly in R&D through its provincial enterprise research institute and collaborations with academic institutions, focusing on advanced remediation technologies, industrial pollution treatment, resource recovery, and smart environmental platforms. The company aims to enhance its core technology barriers and expand into new application scenarios aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through EPC and PC project contracting for environmental remediation and pollution control services, technical consulting, and operation management fees. Additionally, the company earns income from sales of environmental protection equipment and related installation, maintenance, and technical services. Revenue recognition is based on contract progress for service projects and delivery for product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private environmental remediation and pollution control enterprise in China, recognized for its strong technical capabilities and comprehensive service offerings. It competes with state-owned enterprises, regional environmental groups, and other private technology-driven firms. The industry is characterized by increasing competition, with national and local government-backed entities holding significant market shares, while private firms like Zhejiang Zone-King focus on innovation and specialized technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 242.5 million, a 30% decrease from the previous year, reflecting industry-wide adjustment and cautious project acceptance. Net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 82.2 million, an improvement compared to prior years. The company’s total assets were about RMB 586 million, with equity of RMB 199 million. Despite recent financial challenges, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues to invest in R&D, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zone-King differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies in soil and groundwater remediation, industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, and resource recovery. It offers integrated, customized environmental solutions combining engineering, technology, and digital management platforms. The company emphasizes high efficiency, environmental safety, odor control, and resource recycling, providing clients with cost-effective, sustainable, and smart environmental services that align with national ecological and carbon reduction policies.
